    13  /-!
    14  # Lie algebras of associative algebras
    15  
    16  This file defines the Lie algebra structure that arises on an associative algebra via the ring
    17  commutator.
    18  
    19  Since the linear endomorphisms of a Lie algebra form an associative algebra, one can define the
    20  adjoint action as a morphism of Lie algebras from a Lie algebra to its linear endomorphisms. We
    21  make such a definition in this file.
    22  
    23  ## Main definitions
    24  
    25  * `LieAlgebra.ofAssociativeAlgebra`
    26  * `LieAlgebra.ofAssociativeAlgebraHom`
    27  * `LieModule.toEnd`
    28  * `LieAlgebra.ad`

    30  * `AlgEquiv.toLieEquiv`

    36  
    37  @[expose] public section
    38

    40  universe u v w w₁ w₂
    41  
    42  section OfAssociative
    43  
    44  variable {A : Type v} [Ring A]
    45  
    46  namespace LieRing
    47  
    48  /-- An associative ring gives rise to a Lie ring by taking the bracket to be the ring commutator. -/
    49  @[instance_reducible]
    50  def ofAssociativeRing : LieRing A where
    51    add_lie _ _ _ := by simp only [Ring.lie_def, right_distrib, left_distrib]; abel

    56

    58    rfl

    60  @[simp]
